anchor.statement: Every bead row stored by beads-cache, including rows ingested from a consumer sync, must pass the strict row decoder generated from bd schema.
anchor.quote: Every bead row stored by beads-cache, including rows ingested from a consumer sync, must pass the strict row decoder generated from bd schema.
anchor.summary: Strict row contract on every ingested row
anchor.scope: any bead that adds or changes a path that stores bead rows, such as sync, fetch or ingest_scope
anchor.deterministic_check: crates/sc-beads/tests/strict_rows.rs::a_bad_row_is_a_contract_error_naming_bead_and_field rejects an unknown bd-row key as BD_CACHE.BD_CONTRACT naming the bead and field; crates/bd-cache/tests/ingest.rs::one_invalid_row_among_valid_ones_stores_none_of_them rejects an ingest row with an unknown key as INGEST_INVALID (row_invalid, row index) and stores no rows, per approved REQ-BDC-0726 and REQ-BDC-0729.

pass: ingest_scope decodes every row with the same strict sc-beads decoder as the built-in sync; test ingest_rejects_unknown_key in crates/bd-cache/tests/ingest.rs passes in CI (run 1234).
fail: ingest_scope stores rows as raw JSON so a consumer sync can add its own fields without validation.
